items.title: John Casimir Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: How long did you stay with Owen Allen? About four or five years.

ctx.x: I tried to find a walk, I couldn't make a note, but I couldn't walk. Watch another fellow. And the Santa Father can't get out there playing a little funeral. You got to learn how to play a funeral. You got to learn how to play a funeral. Any God to know that, you got to learn how to play a funeral.
How long did you stay with Owen Allen? About four or five years.

Then I started playing with Henry Red Allen, his son, you know. Me and him and Johnny had a little four piece band. He was in short band, really. A little four piece band? A little four piece house band. I had Mitchell in the band, got Lucha on, Albojack on, Tramble. We got a little six piece band. We got all them jobs going down to Delco Island. Who's Mitchell?
